subject.title: fix(agent): stale replies after queued user turns

question: Should legitimate queued user-authored orphan turns be preserved as context-only before the latest active prompt, while internal inter-session completion leaves are dropped, as this PR implements?
rationale: Both preserving and dropping an older queued turn can prevent stale replies, but they differ in whether user-authored input remains available to the model; source inspection cannot choose that product semantic on maintainers' behalf.

options.title: Preserve queued user context
options.body: Accept this PR's semantics: retain legitimate queued user content behind an explicit context-only marker, drop internal completion leaves, and answer the latest active prompt.

options.title: Drop every older orphan
options.body: Remove all older orphaned user leaves when a fresh prompt exists, reducing stale steering but potentially discarding legitimate queued user input.

options.title: Pause both candidates
options.body: Keep both PRs open until maintainers define a different transcript-level queued-turn contract and corresponding proof requirements.

recommendation.title: Preserve queued user context
recommendation.body: Accept this PR's semantics: retain legitimate queued user content behind an explicit context-only marker, drop internal completion leaves, and answer the latest active prompt.

likelyOwner.reason: The current assignee authored the latest combined implementation and is best positioned to confirm or route the intended session semantics.
